_comment: Site-wide build settings. `noindex` is false per the owner's July-17 launch decision (prices are already public via Linktree; menus should be searchable). `forbidden_strings` are scanned across the whole built site (spec 5.1 / 8.7) — the build FAILS if any appears.
_supplier_comment: Supplier guard (Oct 21): every Supplier Name in the base (Suppliers table, fetched and cursor-checked like Products) is ALSO forbidden, scanned over HTML and PDF text. Suppliers that are also product brands customers must see are allow-listed here (supplier name -> the brand customers read).
_global_exclude_comment: GUARD-FIRST (Oct 20): SKUs starting with these prefixes are dropped at load and never render on any page/PDF or enter the snapshot. STKR-CUSTOM-STD/-PRM/-CNSR are the new one-per-tier sticker items (size on the order line, no price breaks) - forms-side only; the stickers menu is priced from the forms quote endpoint instead. Check 16 pins this.
